description: This file defines an interface for CRON field handling, specifying methods for evaluating if a date/time satisfies a cron expression, incrementing/decrementing date/time objects based on cron fields, and validating cron expressions.

classes.name: FieldInterface
classes.description: Interface for CRON field operations including satisfaction check, increment/decrement, and validation methods.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if a given DateTime object satisfies a specific CRON expression value.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adjusts a DateTime object by a CRON field unit, either incrementing or decrementing based on the 'invert' parameter.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CRON expression string to determine if it is well-formed and valid for the field.
